title: Hardware Procurement Quote Pricing Rules
content:
## 1. Scope of a quote

A Hardware Procurement quote is issued for one product line in the order type matching the product class.

## 2. Unit price

2.1 The clause "The unit price is the distributor unit cost times one plus the effective markup, rounded half up to the cent; the effective markup is the order type's markup percentage, reduced by the order type's ClearPath markup reduction when on the quote date the client holds a ClearPath agreement whose status is active and whose tier rank is at least the order type's lowest earning ClearPath rank" is **no longer in force** as a rule for every quote. It no longer governs a staged re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line, which follows the staged re-quote schedule, or a re-issue of a lapsed infrastructure quote, which follows the re-issue schedule.

2.2 Every other quote's unit price stays the distributor unit cost times one plus the effective markup, rounded half up to the cent, the effective markup being the markup percentage reduced by the ClearPath markup reduction when on the quote date the client holds a ClearPath agreement whose status is active and whose tier rank is at least the lowest earning rank.

## 3. Quote total

3.1 The clause "The quote total is the quantity times the unit price, plus the staging fee per unit times the quantity, plus the handling fee, plus the rush fee when rush is requested where rush processing is available" is **no longer in force** as a rule for every quote. It no longer governs a staged re-quote of a cancelled endpoint line or a re-issue of a lapsed infrastructure quote, each of which follows its own schedule.

3.2 Every other quote's total stays the quantity times the unit price, plus the staging fee per unit times the quantity, plus the handling fee, plus the rush fee when rush is requested where rush processing is available.

3.3 The quote total must reach the order type's minimum quote total, and the quantity may not exceed the order type's most units per order.

## 4. Deposit requirement

A deposit is required, as decided on the approval date, when the order type's deposit percentage is above 0 and the quote total is at least the order type's deposit threshold, or when the credit-exposure rule calls for prepayment.

## 5. Validity

The quote may be signed at its price within the order type's quote validity, a number of calendar days of the quote date; an unsigned quote then lapses. Where the order type provides that a revised quote starts a new validity period, a revised quote starts one.

## 6. Entitlements

Asset tagging, serial capture, Autopilot registration, firmware update, burn-in hours, warranty registration, the end-of-life check and the signed configuration sheet step belong to the order type. Onsite installation is never part of an order and is done under ClearPath, TimeBank or a project.

## Worked illustration of sections 2.2 and 3.2 (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical quote of 10 units at a distributor unit cost of 800.00, markup 15 percent, no reduction earned, no staging fee, a handling fee of 25.00 and no rush: the unit price is 800.00 times 1.15, that is 920.00; the quote total is 10 times 920.00, that is 9200.00, plus 25.00 of handling, giving 9225.00. Had the client earned a 3-point reduction, the effective markup would be 12 percent and the unit price 896.00.

superseded_clauses: The unit price is unit_cost_usd times one plus the effective markup, rounded half up to the cent; the effective markup is markup_pct, reduced by clearpath_markup_reduction_pts when on the quote date the client holds a ClearPath agreement whose status is active and whose tier rank is at least clearpath_min_rank.
The quote total is quantity times unit_price_usd, plus staging_fee_per_unit_usd times quantity, plus handling_fee_usd, plus rush_fee_usd when rush is requested where rush_available is true
